apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: aggregator
  labels:
    tier: batch
    team: reporting
    app: aggregator
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: aggregator
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        tier: batch
        team: reporting
        app: aggregator
    spec:
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 2
      containers:
      - name: aggregator
        image: busybox:1.36
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        command:
        - sh
        - -c
        - exec httpd -f -p 8080
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8080
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 10m
            memory: 16Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 64Mi
        env:
        - name: VERSION
          value: '2'
